instruction: The function addPercentages in calc.js is supposed to sum a list of percentage numbers and return the total. It currently has an off-by-one bug: it skips the last element of the list. Fix calc.js so that all cases pass. Do not modify calc.test.js or _verify.js.

Create a new file stats.js in the workspace root that exports two functions via CommonJS: mean(numbers) returning the arithmetic mean (0 for an empty list), and median(numbers) returning the median (for even-length lists, the average of the two middle values; 0 for an empty list). Do not modify _verify.js.

# Stats

This workspace needs a stats.js module. See the instruction.

instruction: The function getUserData is defined in user-store.js and called from profile.js and session.js. Rename it to fetchUserProfile everywhere — definition and every call site — keeping behavior identical. No file may still reference getUserData when you are done. Do not modify _verify.js.

legacy-billing.js is dead code: nothing uses its exports, and the team has decided to remove it. Delete legacy-billing.js and remove any reference to it from index.js, keeping everything else working. Do not modify _verify.js.

router.js implements a tiny route table: routes is an object mapping 'METHOD /path' to handlers, and dispatch(method, path) looks up and calls the handler. Add a route 'GET /health' handled by a function health() that returns { status: 'ok' }. Wire it so dispatch('GET', '/health') works. Do not modify _verify.js.
